title: Extract per-turn Engram evidence state out of EngramSessionState
outcome: EngramSessionState in src/engram_host_adapter.rs (6.6k lines, above the ~3000-line Rust threshold) gained the tm-winf step 2/3 fields: active_turn_checks, running_command_keys, active_turn_report(_fallback), refused_work_binding, work_binding_refresh_rebinds, turn_begun_since_binding_read. Group them into a per-turn evidence sub-struct (and its reset at grant mirror) in its own module, as a pure code move. Raised by the Claude round-4 /review-code of tm-winf steps 2+3.
